author: Azurastrike
quote: Masterpiece. 10 out of 10. Beautiful game, perfect game, I don't know how many times I cried playing it. No bugs, polished at a stable 60fps, gorgeous effects, it brings out the best in the Switch 2. I thought they couldn't outdo themselves and they did.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Azurastrike
quote: I tried it on PS5 and Xbox and there's no way around it — it's full of bugs, it went woke, everything's wrong, the open world is broken. 10 years waiting for nothing.

author: Azurastrike
quote: Full of bugs. The game restarted on me several times, I lost my save data, lots of polygon models and pixels weren't loading for stretches — at times it looked like a PSX game. Paying $100 for a borrowed game that isn't even yours, and recommending a $1000 PS5 Pro to play it at 30fps with drops to 20fps, is lying to the consumer and disrespecting the user. This is BUG THEFT WOKE 6.
